{{Top|leg}}
A '''Silornia Force Crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from the [[Silorna system/Legends|Silorna system]]. One was on sale at [[Nenmo's Curios]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], just after the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'' had been held, during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
